 Cut Bank Holiday Bazaar Returns Nov.14
 Last updated Nov 03, 2026 3:22pm 0 
 Share 
 A day of holiday shopping, local vendors, and community fun awaits at Cut Bank High School.
 The holiday season is just around the corner, and the Cut Bank Chamber of Commerce is inviting the community to kick off the festivities at its annual Holiday Bazaar on Saturday, Nov. 14.
 The event will take place from 9 a.m. to 3:30 p.m. at Cut Bank High School, located at 101 3rd Avenue SE in Cut Bank. With over 70 vendors, unique gift ideas, and plenty of holiday spirit, the bazaar offers an opportunity for community members to shop local, discover handmade treasures, and find something special for everyone on their holiday shopping list.
 Holiday bazaars have long been a favorite way for communities to come together, and this year's event promises a welcoming atmosphere for shoppers of all ages. Whether visitors are looking for handcrafted gifts, seasonal decorations, specialty items, or simply a fun way to spend a Saturday, the bazaar offers a chance to explore what local and regional vendors have to offer.
 In addition to shopping, visitors can stop by the food area for a selection of crowd favorites, including baked potatoes, chili, hot dogs, taco-in-a-bag, cinnamon rolls, donuts, and more. It's the perfect opportunity to take a break from shopping, enjoy a bite to eat, and visit with friends and neighbors.
 Families are also invited to bring their little ones for a special visit with Santa, who will be at the bazaar from 11 a.m. to 12:30 p.m. The visit offers a fun opportunity for children to share their Christmas wishes and get into the holiday spirit.
 Admission is $3 per person for ages five and older, making the bazaar an affordable outing for the entire family. Visitors can also participate in the event raffle, with tickets available for $1 each or an arm's length for $20.
 Beyond the shopping and festivities, the Holiday Bazaar serves an important purpose: bringing people together and supporting the small businesses, makers, and entrepreneurs who help make our communities special. Events like this provide vendors with an opportunity to showcase their products, connect with customers, and share their creativity with the public.
 The Cut Bank Chamber of Commerce encourages residents to invite their friends and family, come hungry, and plan to spend part of their Saturday enjoying everything the bazaar has to offer.
 As the holiday season approaches, the Holiday Bazaar is a reminder that some of the most meaningful gifts can be found close to home-and that supporting local businesses helps keep our communities thriving.
 Mark your calendars for Saturday, Nov. 14, and join the Cut Bank Chamber of Commerce for a day of shopping, food, family fun, and holiday cheer!
